title: Customer Account (Sage)

fields.label: Sage Account Number
fields.name: sage_account_number
fields.instructions: The customer's account reference in Sage 50. Populated automatically by the sync connector.

fields.label: Sage Last Sync
fields.name: sage_last_sync
fields.instructions: Automatically updated by the sync connector. Do not edit manually.

fields.label: Customer Type
fields.name: customer_type
fields.instructions: Used to apply role-based pricing rules and determine available payment methods.

fields.label: Approved to Pay on Account
fields.name: pay_on_account_approved
fields.instructions: Off by default. When off, the Invoice (pay on account) method is hidden at checkout and refused if requested directly. Only tick this for customers Sage has approved for credit. Maintained by hand until the Sage sync takes it over.

description: Sage 50 account linkage and customer-specific pricing. Shown on the admin user edit screen only. Trimmed 2026-06-10 to the fields the Kryptronic data and Sage integration actually use: pay-on-account, VAT-exemption and notes fields were removed for zero usage on the old site. pay_on_account_approved was restored 2026-08-06 for DR-11, which is a forward requirement (spec 5.x, only Sage-approved customers may pay on account) rather than migrated data, so zero usage on Kryptronic is not a reason to remove it again. VAT exemption may return the same way under DR-12.
